messages:
Keiko: Kickoff: we need a compact RefKit for cloud partner listing. Deliverables: terraform module, tiny example (3 cmds), CI smoke, short ops playbook, and listing assets. Goal: internal alpha in 6 days.
Omar: I'll scaffold the TF module and examples/basic. Will include required_version and provider hints.
Lucas: I'll own CI + pre-commit hooks. Plan: run terraform init, validate, fmt-check in GH Actions and a tiny matrix for x86/arm.
Maya: I'll draft the README + two diagrams (logical + ops) and a 200-char blurb for the marketplace.
Keiko: constraints: icon 64x64 PNG, screenshots scrubbed, LICENSE included, and short compatibility table (aws/gcp regions, arch).
Lucas: CI snippet I'll add:
```
name: refkit-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [x86, arm]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
      - run: terraform init -input=false
      - run: terraform validate
      - run: terraform fmt -check
```
Omar: i'll include examples/quickstart with 3 cmds: git clone, terraform init, terraform apply -var-file=quick.tfvars. Keep vars minimal so CI can plan fast.
Maya: diagrams will include mermaid source + PNG, and a short "what to watch" list (latency, KV cache hit, disk).
Keiko: timeline: today owners set. +2 days: PRs for module + README. +4 days: CI + assets. +6 days: publish to partner staging and run smoke.
Lucas: I'll stub the GH action tonight so CI runs on PR. Also add .pre-commit-config for fmt + tflint.
Maya: I'll post the blurb and icon guidance; Omar please link module PR when ready.
product-partner-bot: REMINDER: upload packaging assets to /partner-artifacts and run `./scripts/market-validate.sh` before requesting the staging publish.
Keiko: Who will do the staging verification sign-off? need one person to approve after smoke.
Lucas: I can sign off if CI and metadata lint pass.
Omar: PR planned tomorrow morning.
Maya: I'll push diagrams tonight and link to PR.
Keiko: Thanks all ":thumbsup:". I'll create the tracking ticket and assign tasks.
